instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `hsd_fpga.ipc2581` is on the desktop. Export its stackup/cross-section information to `stackup_report.json`. Requirements: - Report `layer_count`, `signal_layers`, `plane_layers`, and `average_dielectric_constant`. - Include `layers` as the complete list of layer names in source stack order; preserve source order within the category lists too. [Software] For this workflow, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`. Save the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`.
